detail.longDescription:
Rex puts every terminal session from your Mac, Linux, and Windows machines on your iPhone and iPad. Your sessions keep running on your computers and Rex lets you see them, type into them, and move between them from anywhere.

PAIR IN SECONDS
Scan a QR code to pair with a Rex server or add a host by address. Rex reconnects on its own when you come back to the app, and your screens survive a dropped connection.

SESSIONS, TABS, AND PANES
Browse every live session across all your machines, filter by host, and search by name. Open a session and swipe between its panes. Your desktop layout stays exactly as you left it.

A REAL TERMINAL
Rex is built on a fast, native terminal engine with full color, selection, scrolling, and clipboard support. Use the software keyboard with a row of Escape, Tab, Ctrl-C, and arrow keys, or plug in a hardware keyboard with adjustable key repeat.

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR AGENTS
Long-running coding agents, builds, and test runs keep going on your machine. Glance at progress, answer a prompt, or approve a command without going back to your desk.

HANDOFF
Move the pane on your iPhone or iPad straight to Rex on your Mac, and back again.
